capabilities: Display live numbering labels next to headings in Live Preview and Reading view
Bake numbers into the current note's Markdown and strip them again later
Choose numbering presets or build custom formats from tokens like {dotted}, {roman}, and {zh}
Override numbering per note with frontmatter keys for on/off, style, and start number
Export and import plugin settings as a JSON file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Baking only affects the current note, not the whole vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display or insert hierarchical outline numbers on headings the way Word's multilevel numbering does.
